  0 < n →
    ∀ (tau : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < tau i) →
        Monotone tau →
          ∀ (S : ℕ),
            0 < S →
              ∃ j,
                (∀ (k : Fin n),
                    OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S j ≤ OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S k) ∧
                  (∀ (k : Fin n),
                      OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S k = OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S j →
                        j ≤ k) ∧
                    tau j < OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S j ∧
                      have B := fun i => if i ≤ j then OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S j / tau i - 1 else 0;
                      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ B i) ∧
                        (∀ i ≤ j, 0 < B i) ∧
                          ∑ i, B i = ↑S ∧
                            ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < B i → tau i * (1 + B i) ≤ OracleTemplate.Rennala.allocationTime tau S j
